authored_by: hand-authored for this run; see RESULT.md FINDING F-1
why_hand_authored: crosslayer_search_space.py names eight PnR levers under `pnr_levers_excluded_on_purpose` with the reason 'these are the place-and-route knobs the PnR-only search already owns'. Measured on this tree: no program under programs/ emits that PnR-only space. So the space below is authored here, in crosslayer_search_space.py's own output shape, and every lever cites the shipped CLI flag that actually applies it.

levers.domain: global placement density passed to OpenROAD global_placement
die W x H in microns, or `auto` to size from cell count / site area / target util
design-for-ECO spare-cell density as a fraction of placed cells, clamped to [0, 0.2]

exclusion_reason: clock_period is part of the PROBLEM identity: moving it makes two runs incomparable under docs/PPA_INTERFACES.md section 2, not a better implementation. The other five are the cross-layer arm's levers (crosslayer_search_space.py) and every one of them requires authoring different RTL, which this run did not do -- the RTL is byte-identical across all 60 trials, which is what makes `implementation differs, problem identical` true here.
